{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
internal_test_rows = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders, excluding internal test orders
completed_orders_filtered = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders)
total_revenue = completed_orders_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders (after filtering internal test): {len(completed_orders_filtered)}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
